C1793.title: Zendesk Acquisition Exposes Customer Data Integration Risks in Service Desk SaaS
C1793.summary: In June 2022, Zendesk was acquired for $10.2 billion. As a leading global customer service SaaS platform, Zendesk's ticketing and support systems integrate vast amounts of enterprise customer privacy and business data.
